observations: Photo 0: Front-loading washing machine, white body, branded LG on top left panel.
Text on panel reads 'Inverter DirectDrive 7kg' with a model code partly legible as F1068QDP2.
Rotary dial control with wash cycle options (Cotton, Synthetic, Delicate, Baby Care, Hand Wash/Wool, Blanket, Quick 30, Rinse+Spin).
Digital display panel with buttons for Spin and Temp, and indicator icons.
Green sticker on door reads 'Less Noise, Less Vibration, More Durability' with LG Inverter logo.
'10 Year Warranty' and 'DD Motor' emblem on upper right of door area.
Visible rust spots along the top edge and lower front panel near the base.
Door glass appears intact, no visible cracks.
Small drawer/access panel visible at bottom front, slightly ajar.
Unit sits on a bare concrete/tiled floor, placed against a light blue wall, with wooden crates and boxes nearby.
No visible power cord, hoses, or detergent drawer in this shot.
